instruction: You are given a cylinder crossflow template `/home/user/Desktop/cylinder_base/`. Complete a transient vortex-shedding analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/cylinder/`: - Complete boundary conditions on the cylinder surface - Set inflow conditions and properties so Reynolds number is in the vortex-shedding range - Configure transient solver parameters 2. Run the solver. 3. Monitor the lift time history on the cylinder surface and verify periodic vortex shedding. 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Peak lift coefficient `cl_max` - Format: `cl_max` 5. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
